parent.P60_ARCH_negative: factual history and TTT not necessary in fully-observed imitation

scope: Independent policy-search study, NOT another native Hybrid architecture or neural-model training result; do not conflate with P60 ARCH. Reward-only means optimizer sees only completed physical net returns and actual actions, never expert actions or future source outcomes.

prefreeze_pilot.method: 180 random parameter proposals in each of history and memoryless classes; observe whether some controllers can solve authored published-equation simulator; NOT frozen-source science and NEVER use these resets in new fit/validation/OOD
prefreeze_pilot.pilot_result: history 79/180 params had at least one successful physical episode; memoryless 0/180
prefreeze_pilot.timing: occurred before prospective freeze; disclosed, cannot claim fully preregistered method conception

source.physical_stepping: original published_reset/published_step from exact P54 pinned published-equation transcription (NOT installed official Gymnasium)
source.reward: physical terminal +100 on goal, minus 0.1*actually executed motor^2 per step
source.partial_observation: motor policy only sees current physical POSITION; history policy additionally receives the last observed POSITION CHANGE after at least one executed motor action; physical velocity is hidden from all learned policies
source.global_source_rule: no P58 985xxx or P59 986xxx or earlier pilot 988xxx evaluation source seeds reused

proposal_classes.history: theta in R^3 acts sign(theta0 * [100*last position change] + theta1*[4*(position+.5)] + theta2), with last position change zero before first executed action
proposal_classes.memoryless: theta in R^3 acts sign(theta0*[4*(position+.5)] + theta1*[4*(position+.5)]^3 + theta2), identical 3 tunable parameters without observed history
proposal_classes.random_search_history: same history model family; sample all candidates independently from original fixed Gaussian proposal without CEM adaptation, select best from equal physical training episodes
proposal_classes.CEM_wrong_credit: same history CEM proposals but permute *episode mean returns across candidates* before updating search distribution; final selection tracks these corrupted scores, never present as positive evidence
proposal_classes.reference_finite_difference: hand-designed conventional sign(last observed position change), first step negative; same hidden-velocity observation budget as candidate, strong control
proposal_classes.reference_momentum: original P58 conventional momentum controller uses true velocity, hence PRIVILEGED full-state comparator, not a fair learner
proposal_classes.random_actions: actual signed independent random motor choices with rng seeded by (990000+physical_seed) separate policy control, no hidden future

training.optimizer: bounded diagonal cross-entropy method (CEM) on physical episodic returns, never gradients/teacher labels
training.policy_family_init: theta ~ Normal(mu=[0,0,0],sigma=[1,1,.25]); CEM new means = elite mean, sigmas = max(0.05, elite std) with 0.5 smoothing; random baseline samples original Gaussian all 120 candidates
training.objective: maximize mean reward over eight completed actual physical trajectories per sampled theta
training.selected_policy: best physically observed mean return across all evaluated candidates under each method; no post-result parameter tuning
training.rng: identical model seed per arm and iteration; each candidate each generation evaluated on identical eight reset seeds; comparison is equal episode opportunity but not guaranteed equal source steps due termination
training.cost: count exact executed physical steps and returns; report whole process wall; no neural training or matched FLOPs claim

per_seed_oodA_and_oodB: history-CEM goal success >= learned memoryless CEM +.50
history-CEM goal success >= finite-difference baseline success -.05
history-CEM average physical net return >= finite-difference baseline mean reward -10
strict_method_superiority_each_seed: history-CEM goal success >= equal-budget history random search +.05 on BOTH OOD cohorts
history-CEM physical net reward >= equal-budget random search +5 on BOTH OOD cohorts
history-CEM goal success >= reward-shuffled CEM +.25 on BOTH OOD cohorts
negative_controls: same actual observed starting state and max 256 motor opportunities for all arms; early terminal natural episodes allowed and actual steps reported
no model uses true velocity; reference original momentum explicitly labeled privileged
zero history ablation on fitted history theta: force last delta to zero; goal success drops by at least .50 each seed
bit-exact final frozen model parameter JSON cold restoration and action decision
frozen_gates.science: Even a positive reward-only CEM in a 3-param velocity-sign policy family does not establish native Hybrid/TTT action-consequence reasoning, learned general model, scientific PASS, model-free neural learning, unfamiliar dynamics or autonomous RSI. The architecture still requires matched GRU/MLP/Hybrid trained from reward-only actions on independently qualified external physics.
